false_negative_justification.r1_contract_interpretation: R1 artifact_contract description lists 'fuzzer_stats, manifest JSON, trace files' without explicitly enumerating nv_probe.json or nv_state_db.json as required artifacts
false_negative_justification.validator_behavior: Validator implementation requires probe and state_db files beyond the frozen R1 semantic specification
false_negative_justification.architectural_correctness: Absence of probe/state_db is the correct outcome when zero HTTP requests are sent due to body validation rejection

recommended_resolution.option_1: Apply Phase 3 workaround: create empty probe/state_db files to satisfy validator while preserving scientific integrity

recommended_resolution.option_3: Create R2 execution freeze with explicit artifact contract clarification and validator alignment
